product_one_liner.value: Sitetracker is asset lifecycle management software for critical-infrastructure owners and operators, helping them plan, build, operate, maintain, and manage their assets.
product_one_liner.notes: Sitetracker describes its product as asset lifecycle management for asset owners and operators and says it covers critical-infrastructure projects and the asset lifecycle.

pricing_page.notes: The site crawl reports that the /pricing path is missing and no pricing page appears in the company sitemap; the homepage instead presents a live-demo call to action. This supports no public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Sitetracker’s homepage displays Ericsson and EVgo as customer logos. | named_customers.0: The homepage labels Ericsson as a customer logo. | named_customers.1: The homepage labels EVgo as a customer logo.

employee_band.notes: The company’s LinkedIn profile gives its company-size band as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Sitetracker’s company profile identifies Montclair, New Jersey as its headquarters location. | hq_country: Sitetracker’s company profile identifies its Montclair, New Jersey headquarters as being in the United States.

founded_year.notes: Sitetracker’s LinkedIn company profile states that it was founded in 2013.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows industry, product, and business-oriented posts about solar development, EV charging, AI, and project financial systems. The index does not establish at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built, so this is not an engineering blog under the stated criterion.

public_docs.notes: The available API listing says Sitetracker has no public developer portal or API reference and that integration documentation is behind a Salesforce Community login. The homepage content reviewed offers a demo rather than a public product-docs or help link, supporting false.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job listing is titled Senior Software Engineer II - AI and includes an application link, meeting the AI-role title criterion.

model_provider.notes: The Sitetracker AI engineering job description says its product features use frontier models from Anthropic and OpenAI.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The trust center lists SOC 2 Type II reports and an ISO 27001:2022 certification. These are the qualifying certifications named on that page. | compliance_certs.0: The trust center names a Sitetracker SOC 2 Type II report. | compliance_certs.1: The trust center names Sitetracker’s ISO 27001:2022 certification.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest funding record names a Series D, and Sitetracker’s financing announcement also identifies the $96 million financing as Series D. | funding_date: The funding record identifies the latest funding date as 2022-10-12, which gives the requested YYYY-MM value of 2022-10. | funding_amount_usd: Sitetracker’s financing announcement states that its Series D equity-and-debt financing was $96 million.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded round is dated October 2022, well before the 18-month window beginning in May 2025, so the evidence indicates no qualifying raise within the window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job listing is for a Strategic Enterprise Account Executive, which is a qualifying account-executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 23, 2026 announcement says Sitetracker and 5×5 Technologies introduced a data-to-twin workflow. This falls within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The directory covers 41 decision-makers and says its leadership-role data was updated in November 2026, but it does not establish C-level or VP employment start or departure dates. Its dated June 2026 appointment is for a Senior Partner Business Manager, not a C-level or VP role. The available sources therefore do not establish whether a qualifying leadership change occurred.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Sitetracker sales-development job post mentions Salesforce tracking, and a DocSend customer case study says Sitetracker uses DocSend for sales collateral and sales/marketing alignment. | crm_stack_signal.0: A Sitetracker sales-development job post explicitly names Salesforce tracking. | crm_stack_signal.1: The DocSend case study says Sitetracker uses DocSend for finalized sales collateral and sales/marketing.
